description: Domain registration data from RDAP. Use when a task needs when a domain was registered or expires, which registrar holds it, its nameservers and registry status codes, from the registry's own RDAP service rather than a scraped WHOIS page. Contact details of people are omitted. Cost: 1 credit per call.

domain.description: The registered domain, such as example.com. A URL is accepted and its host is used; www. is dropped, and a subdomain is reported under parent_registered.

name: rdap_lookup
